title: Hackers reportedly breached an open-source intelligence platform used by US agencies, relayed from the New York Times
date_note: The relaying pages give only the day of the New York Times report, 24 November.
geo_basis: United States, where the agencies are based
summary: RBC Ukraine, citing the New York Times, says an open-source intelligence platform used by the CIA, the Office of the Director of National Intelligence and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency may have been hit. Officials say secret networks were not affected and the incident has been fixed, and have not said what data was accessed. RBC says initial signs point to Chinese involvement, but the attackers are not identified.
plain: RBC Ukraine, citing the New York Times, says a US intelligence open-source analysis platform may have been breached. Officials say secret networks were not affected and it is fixed.
exec: Per the New York Times as relayed by RBC Ukraine, a platform used by US intelligence agencies may have been breached; officials say secret networks were unaffected.

sources.name: RBC Ukraine (relaying the New York Times)

validation.note: Two Ukrainian publishers read (RBC Ukraine, 112 Ukraine), both relaying the New York Times / Bloomberg reporting, which was not read (the NYT page was not found; searches returned nothing). No US agency statement was read.
